connector.name: Monarch Money by pulsemcp.com
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Monarch Money - account, transaction, and budget management.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package monarch-money-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.pulsemcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MONARCH_SESSION_TOKEN
env.description: Pre-obtained session token for authentication (recommended over email/password).

env.name: MONARCH_TOTP
env.description: TOTP code if 2FA is enabled on the account.

env.name: MONARCH_EMAIL_OTP
env.description: Email OTP code required only on first login from a new install.

env.name: MONARCH_SESSION_PASSPHRASE
env.description: Override passphrase for encrypting the on-disk session file.

env.name: MONARCH_STATE_DIR
env.description: Directory where session.enc file is stored.

env.name: MONARCH_ENABLED_TOOL_GROUPS
env.description: Comma-separated list of tool groups to enable (readonly, manage).

env.name: MONARCH_ENABLED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated whitelist of specific tool names to enable.

env.name: MONARCH_DISABLED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated blacklist of specific tool names to disable.
